import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    slow = 0
    fast = 1
    count = 1
    ans = 0
    
    while fast < len(str_input):
        ch = str_input[slow]
        ch1 = str_input[fast]
        
        if ch == ch1:
            count += 1
        else:
            if count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            slow = fast
            count = 1
        fast += 1
        
    if count % 2 == 0:
        ans += 1
        
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
